name: agentfloat-frontend
description: AgentFloat dashboard — budget-controlled MUSD payments for AI agents on Mezo

scripts.//build: Invokes node directly with a larger heap rather than `NODE_OPTIONS=... vite build`, which does not work in Windows cmd/PowerShell. Privy + WalletConnect + the x402 SDK make the dependency graph big enough to exhaust the default ~1GB old-space during Rollup.
scripts.//check:deps: Crawls the module graph Vite is actually serving and fails if any CommonJS file is reaching the browser raw — the cause of 'does not provide an export named default' from Privy. Run it after bumping @privy-io/* or @x402/*. Needs the dev server running.
scripts.//check:privy: Queries Privy for the live app config behind VITE_PRIVY_APP_ID and asserts the four things AgentFloat needs: embedded wallets created on login, smart wallets OFF, the right login methods enabled, and localhost in allowed_domains. Diagnoses a modal that opens and silently closes.
scripts.//check:client: Greps THIS machine's frontend source for known-stale patterns — StrictMode in main.jsx, double createRoot, un-nested createOnLogin, usePrivy().login. Built because files are copied by hand, and a stale main.jsx looks exactly like a broken Privy modal.
scripts.//test:network: Unit tests for the wallet network switch/add state machine against a fake EIP-1193 provider. Runs in plain Node — no browser, no build.
scripts.//test:x402: Offline tests for the BROWSER half of an x402 payment: the signer shape the scheme requires, the protocol-version header name (v1 X-PAYMENT vs v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE), and offer parsing for both versions. Fake EIP-1193 provider, stubbed fetch — no browser, no Privy, no network.
scripts.//test:permit2: Offline tests for the Permit2 approval a user signs from the browser: the two choices (exact amount vs unlimited), the calldata, sending through the raw provider with no gas fields, and confirming by polling the allowance instead of tx.wait(). Fake EIP-1193 provider, injected reader — no browser, no chain.
scripts.//test:autopay: OFFLINE: the automated-spending state machine — schedule clamping, run classification, what actually moved, when the loop must stop, and which run a cap refuses. No browser, wallet or chain needed.
scripts.//test:charts: Offline tests for the chart arithmetic in src/lib/charts-data.js: the UTC day boundary, kept-empty buckets, BigInt sums that survive unsummable records, and a cross-check that the frontend buckets a receipt into the same day server/spend.js counts it toward the cap.
scripts.//test:auth: OFFLINE: the sign-in failure copy. Asserts that a person closing the login popup is reported as a dismissal and not a failure, that no maintainer vocabulary (npm run, VITE_, iframe, status.privy.com) reaches the user-facing sentence for any code, that the technical detail still exists behind a disclosure, and that every tone the classifier emits is one the toast can render. Also drives the DOM probe with a fake document to prove it detects a double-mounted provider. No browser, no network, no .env.
scripts.//gateway: The gateway now lives at the repo root (../server). Its .env is loaded by absolute path, so cwd does not matter.
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n gateway,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run gateway" "npm run dev"

//gateway-deps: The agent gateway lives at ../server (repo root) and has its own package.json, so the x402 SDK — which pulls a heavy Solana transitive tree — never touches the React build. Install it with: cd ../server && npm install
//overrides: If you install the x402 SDK here instead, add an override for @solana/kit to 6.9.0 — v6.10.0 references unpublished sub-packages and breaks install. See DEPLOYMENT-BRIEF.md §6.
//privy: Set VITE_PRIVY_APP_ID in frontend/.env to enable Google/email login. Without it the app runs in operator-wallet mode only and the login button explains why.
//x402-in-browser: Signed-in users pay from their OWN Privy wallet in the browser, so the x402 client SDK is bundled here too. That pulls a heavy Solana transitive tree; the override above pins @solana/kit to a version that installs.
